d: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical is globally expanding its Embedded Devices Software Solution Sales team, hiring managers, directors, and account managers to broaden reach in mission-critical industries. The successful candidates will focus on our Ubuntu product portfolio, which is already widely used in connected devices and industrial PCs. Our newer offering, Ubuntu Core for IoT, provides state-of-the-art security and resilience for high-end appliances and equipment, serving global brands in consumer, industrial electronics, automotive, and robotics. We are continually enhancing this portfolio with features like real-time Linux capability and pursuing various certifications, representing Linux reinvented for optimal reliability, security, developer productivity, and footprint. We seek technically skilled professionals familiar with embedded Linux and RTOS.

This is a high-energy role focused on prospecting sales and strategic account development, demanding ambition and focus. You will be responsible for carrying an annual bookings quota and must be comfortable positioning and selling a range of open source, services, and software solutions. Leveraging Ubuntu's market adoption, the work requires actively building trusted and profitable commercial relationships, developing the potential of your territory beyond managing inbound interest. This involves prospecting new business, maintaining existing relationships, and working with colleagues on account strategy. Candidates must be effective in selling complex technical solutions, including enterprise software, cloud, virtualization, and container technologies, to senior levels of the enterprise and departments focused on embedded software and IoT devices. Professional practice, clear account planning, continuous pipeline reporting, and the ability to travel regionally for client engagement and internationally for company events twice a year are expected.
Location: We are growing our sales reach with remote roles in all regions - EMEA, APAC, and Americas; and office based roles in Taipei, Taiwan.

d: Pall Corporation | A Danaher Life Sciences Company
Location: Kuwait with periodic travel across GCC
Find what drives you on a team with more than 75 years of discovery, determination, and innovation.

At Pall Corporation, a global leader in high-tech filtration, separation, and purification, we help customers solve some of their toughest operational and process challenges. Our technologies support critical applications across industries, advancing health, safety, sustainability, and environmental responsibility.

Pall is part of Danaher Life Sciences, where our operating companies work together to accelerate the discovery, development, and delivery of solutions that safeguard and improve human health. Through the Danaher Business System, we continuously improve how we serve customers, solve problems, and deliver meaningful impact.

The Senior Field Specialist will be responsible for independently performing contamination and filtration technology assessment surveys, as well as supporting the execution of customer rental orders across industrial process environments.
This is a highly field-based technical role, focused mainly on customers in the Energy sector, including Oil & Gas, Refinery, Polymers, and Chemical processes.
The role will be based primarily in Kuwait, with periodic missions across other GCC countries. The expected work pattern is approximately 70–80% at customer sites and 20–30% office-based.
q: The ideal candidate will bring a strong technical foundation and hands-on field experience in industrial process environments.
Degree in Chemical, Process, or Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent relevant industry experience
Strong exposure to Oil & Gas, Refinery, Chemical, or Polymer processes
Experience in filtration, separation, contamination control, process troubleshooting, or field technical service is highly valuable
Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and spoken
Valid passport with ability to travel across GCC countries without restrictions
r: You will lead technical field activities at customer sites, including
Conducting contamination assessment surveys and identifying process bottlenecks or production issues
Preparing field activity documentation such as work protocols, JSA, HIP, and related safety/process documents
Performing contamination sampling and analysis campaigns at customer locations
Defining technical service scope and required field resources
Reviewing technical elements of commercial proposals when required
Attending customer kick-off meetings and executing field activities
Producing daily field reports and final technical campaign reports
Performing laboratory analysis on collected samples
Providing technical recommendations on potential contamination sources and improvement opportunities
Based on assessment findings, you will support customers by identifying and implementing suitable Pall filtration and separation technologies, including:
Evaluating appropriate filtration/separation solutions from Pall’s portfolio
Sizing solutions based on customer process conditions
Conducting site visits to collect installation and commissioning data
Supervising installation, commissioning, and start-up of rental units
Monitoring job progress and performing required analysis
Troubleshooting Pall products and systems at customer sites
Preparing final job reports with clear technical recommendations
x: This role offers the opportunity to work directly with customers on complex process challenges, applying advanced filtration and separation technologies in real industrial environments.
You will be part of a global organization where technical expertise, customer impact, continuous improvement, and career growth are strongly supported through the Danaher Business System.
At Pall, your work can help improve process reliability, reduce contamination risk, enhance operational efficiency, and support safer, cleaner, and more sustainable industrial operations.
